definitions.explanation: An object left behind from the past, especially historical or archaeological artifacts. Can also refer to outdated things that have survived from a previous era.

examples.japanese: ⟦{遺跡|いせき}→遺跡：09527_iseki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{遺物|いぶつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発見|はっけん}→発見：00085_hakken⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Artifacts were discovered at the ruins.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{土器|どき}→土器：09658_doki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{縄文時代|じょうもんじだい}→縄文時代：18895_joumonjidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{遺物|いぶつ}だ。
examples.english: This pottery is a relic from the Jomon period.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{封建時代|ほうけんじだい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{遺物|いぶつ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧すぎない⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is also criticism that the system is nothing more than a relic of the feudal era.

notes:
Used both literally for archaeological finds and figuratively for outdated systems or ideas that linger from a bygone era.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{出土|しゅつど}→出土：11760_shutsudo⟧{遺物|いぶつ} (excavated artifact)
- ⟦{歴史的|れきしてき}→歴史的：05671_rekishiteki⟧{遺物|いぶつ} (historical relic)
- ～⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{遺物|いぶつ} (relic of the ~ era)

Do not confuse with ⟦{異物|いぶつ}→異物：13706_ibutsu⟧ (foreign body/substance), which has the same reading but different kanji and meaning.
